5. Heat cooking oil in a deep pot or large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Add potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in egg yolk mixture.
7. Drop small balls of the potato mixture on to a lightly floured surface and roll into small, slightly flattened cylinders. 
8. Use a fork to prick holes through the top of each potato cylinder. 
9. Fry in hot oil until golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes per side.
